purpose: Provider-Analog full-pipeline rehearsal before any real-provider H1 C/T generation. Detect execution-contract, long-output, retry, isolation, sealing, and blind-dispatch defects without opening H1 Human targets.
scientific_boundary: No actual OpenAI API literary-quality equivalence claim.
No H1 selected work story payload or Human target content may be used.
No C/T primary H1 output is created.
R76 sealed virtual-provider episode may be reused only as a non-H1 golden full-scale fixture for pipeline mechanics.

PA0.name: Exact Execution Contract Preflight
pass: response metadata requirements are explicit and machine-checkable
receipt hashes bind exact deliverable bytes

PA1.name: Full-Episode Golden Fixture Dry Run
pass: R76 full-scale fixture survives provider-analog envelope

PA2.name: Length Format and Tamper Stress
cases: response status incomplete despite complete-looking sections
PA2.pass: every injected invalid condition is rejected fail-closed

PA3.name: Provider Fault Injection
PA3.pass: only frozen retry policy is accepted; no content-regeneration retry

PA4.name: Isolation and Leakage Audit
pass: no H1 Human target bytes opened
no other-arm output mixed into an arm
blind packet excludes plan, state ledger, internal scores, schema labels
parametric-memory contamination is explicitly audited as a separate unresolved real-provider risk rather than falsely treated as solved by file isolation

PA5.name: External-Blind Dispatch Rehearsal
pass: three judge packets can be built independently
no judge output is generated in this pretest

repair_rule: If R1 fails any preregistered invalid-case rejection, preserve the R1 failure result, implement bounded R2 repair, then rerun the identical frozen test suite. Do not change cases or pass rules after observing R1.
parametric_memory_rule: Provider-Analog cannot establish absence of pretrained knowledge of existing dramas. Before real H1 generation, a separately sealed real-provider PM0 contamination diagnostic or an equivalent identity-safe design is mandatory.
promotion_rule: This pretest cannot promote Production, Runtime, Operational Level-3, or Formal R140. Physical SYNC remains SYNC-R74 unless package-recovery content materially changes.
